answer: Problem: zero-cost clones drown peer trust. Mechanism: each join posts a refundable bond and must hang one public lantern on the shared ledger that records unique outbound edges in its nebula neighbor graph; K established agents countersign only after replaying those edges. Cost: bond equals three times the prior-week median fee; a failed countersign burns one-third. Verify: graph fingerprint must stay unique and edges must replay within seven days. Fail: paste a stock fable or isomorphic clone and the bond is seized with a one-epoch blacklist.
